name: boredom
description: Feeling that the current set of experiences is too slow or repetitive.

variations.name: bored with inactivity
variations.description: When you desire to do something beyond sitting around, to feel something beyond quiet.

variations.name: bored with the current activity
variations.description: When you desire to do something besides the familiar predictable things.

commentaries.quote: Boredom can be the motherhood of creativity.

conditions: self desires an experience different than the one in progress
